opening.comment: The agent gave only the company name and did not give their own name, so the greeting is incomplete.

verification.quote: Agent: Name and order number or postcode.
verification.comment: The caller gave a name and order number before any order data was shared, which meets the check, though the agent then misread the order number as 884257 and did not confirm the caller's full name explicitly.

understanding.quote: Agent: Okay, Ahmed. Order 884257, a lamp that €44.50, in transit for 13 working i days. So nothing at all has arrived?
understanding.comment: The agent captured the issue but misstated the order number and asked to confirm a detail the caller had already given, and the transcript shows a stray artifact in the timeline.

resolution_accuracy.quote: Customer: Right. I've open a lost parcel investigation. It closes within 5 working days and then we a replacement within 2 working days.
resolution_accuracy.comment: Policy says a replacement is sent within 3 working days after the investigation closes, and the agent did not correct the caller's 2-day figure; the agent also never stated the timeline itself, so this is a shared error to correct.

process_compliance.quote: Agent: I'm putting you on hold.
process_compliance.comment: The agent placed the caller on hold without asking permission first and did not thank the caller when returning from hold.

communication.quote: Customer: My parcel never arrived. It's been 12 working days and I'm absolutely furious, this is the second time.
communication.comment: The caller said they were absolutely furious and the agent never acknowledged the frustration, responding only with clipped instructions.

closing.quote: Agent: Thanks for calling Tidewell. Goodbye.
closing.comment: The agent asked if there was anything else and closed politely, but the next-step confirmation was given, so the closing is adequate.
